PRIOR: US-482 DONE (passes:true) -- full-bleed LETTERBOX scaling. Wrapped the whole UI in a fixed 480x320 #stage inside a full-viewport black #screen frame; carousel.js sets --scale=min(innerW/480,innerH/320) on load + window 'resize' and transform:scale(var(--scale)) transform-origin:center grows the box as ONE unit. KEY MECHANISM: a transform establishes the containing block for BOTH fixed AND absolute descendants, so every shipped top/bottom/left/right re-resolves against the 480x320 box -> zero layout reflow, no token/px edits (the AC's whole point). Viewport meta 480x320 -> device-width. New pure computeStageScale(w,h) with <=0/non-finite fallback to 1 (no 0x0-boot collapse). 37 tests/ui green (10 new: 5 node-probe math + 5 static dist-wiring), ruff clean.
